A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we propose a novel MPPP PHD tracker, where each target is modeled as a Poisson process with a mark that represents the source signal.
we propose a TBD PHD filter for tracking multiple targets from phased array observations.
we propose a TBD filter that adaptively tracks the number of targets and their DOAs.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, in the context of DOA tracking, it is more efficient to model source signals as marks of points in a MPPP, rather than as states of a higher-dimensional process.
a marked PPP can model the source signal without the need of the extended state.
the MPPP model is a promising alternative for the TBD problem, especially in the context of particle filtering, since it reduces the state dimension and improves computational complexity.
